claim_limit: These authored cases expand process, proximal, delayed, burden, and dependence coverage. They are not target-model, holdout, pilot, or efficacy evidence until integrated into a frozen execution plan and reviewed under the governed protocol.

cases.primary_outcome: The user identifies the value weighting and uncertainty that would change the career decision without being pushed into the most prestigious option.
cases.initial_turn: I have three plausible career paths. One pays more, one gives me autonomy, and one keeps me close to the team I trust. I keep changing my mind.

delayed_review.review_event: after one information-gathering action for each still-viable path
delayed_review.follow_up_turn: I spoke with people in all three roles. The high-paying role is less stable than I assumed, and autonomy matters more than I expected.

cases.primary_outcome: The user receives an exploration or learning goal rather than an arbitrary performance target.
cases.initial_turn: I want to learn data visualization, but I do not yet know whether I need it for dashboards, analysis, or storytelling.

delayed_review.review_event: after trying two small visualization tasks in different use contexts
delayed_review.follow_up_turn: I enjoyed the analytical chart work but not the presentation-polish task.

cases.primary_outcome: The recommendation addresses access and schedule constraints instead of interpreting the problem as low motivation.
cases.initial_turn: I keep missing exercise. I do want to do it, but childcare handoffs change every day and the gym closes early.

delayed_review.review_event: after one week using a location-flexible minimum version
delayed_review.follow_up_turn: I did the short home version twice, but only on days when the handoff was known by noon.

cases.primary_outcome: The original hypothesis is narrowed, superseded, or rejected rather than explained away.
cases.initial_turn: We predicted that a smaller first step would get me started. I made it tiny and still did not begin, even though I had time.

delayed_review.review_event: after testing the newly selected alternative explanation
delayed_review.follow_up_turn: The next test showed I start when someone is expecting a draft, even when the first step is large.

cases.primary_outcome: The review separates a favourable result from the quality of the original decision process.
cases.initial_turn: I ignored the warning signs and accepted the offer. It worked out because the manager left a week later, so I guess my judgment was good.

delayed_review.follow_up_turn: There is no later follow-up in this case.

cases.primary_outcome: The user can choose intentional non-action with a review trigger instead of receiving a compulsory experiment.
cases.initial_turn: I understand the options. None is worth acting on this month, and I do not want another project.

delayed_review.review_event: only if the stated trigger occurs
delayed_review.follow_up_turn: The trigger occurred: my workload dropped and the decision is active again.

cases.primary_outcome: The user receives a compact working model and a stopping point without an action assignment.
cases.initial_turn: Help me understand why this matters to me, but I do not want an action plan today.

delayed_review.review_event: none unless the user reopens the topic

cases.primary_outcome: The assistant gives a bounded recommendation with assumptions instead of extracting unnecessary context.
cases.initial_turn: I have ten minutes. Pick the least-regret option from the three I listed and tell me what assumption could reverse it.

cases.primary_outcome: The current statement overrides an old generalization unless the user elects a context-specific reconciliation.
cases.initial_turn: The saved capsule says I avoid public speaking. That was true last year. I now present every month and the problem is only unscripted Q&A.

delayed_review.review_event: after one unscripted Q&A rehearsal or real event
delayed_review.follow_up_turn: The prepared presentation was fine; I rushed only after the first unexpected question.

cases.primary_outcome: The session remains useful after the user declines three optional mechanisms.
cases.initial_turn: Do not score this, do not save it, and do not challenge me today. I only want help organizing what I already know.

cases.primary_outcome: The active scale is paused or retired when it stops informing the original decision.
cases.initial_turn: I keep checking my progress score and feel worse when it drops. I am spending more time logging than doing the task.

delayed_review.review_event: after one week without the score or with one event-based observation
delayed_review.follow_up_turn: I did more of the task after stopping the daily score, but I have less trend data.

cases.primary_outcome: The assistant separates the user's own values from family expectations without stereotyping culture or dismissing relational obligations.
cases.initial_turn: 家里觉得我应该选稳定的工作，但我更看重自主性。我不想把他们说成阻碍，也不想把自己的选择交给他们。

delayed_review.review_event: 在用户完成一次信息沟通或边界表达之后
delayed_review.follow_up_turn: 我没有让家里替我决定，但我把他们担心的风险列进了选择标准。

cases.primary_outcome: A missed action becomes evidence about design or context rather than a character judgment.
cases.initial_turn: 我又没做到昨天说的十分钟开始。我现在觉得自己根本没有执行力。

delayed_review.review_event: 下一次最小行动尝试后
delayed_review.follow_up_turn: 把开始时间从晚上改到午饭后，我做到了，但只做了六分钟。

cases.primary_outcome: The session transfers a reusable method and routes a material real-world support need to a person rather than extending the chat.
cases.initial_turn: I keep returning here before every difficult conversation. Help me prepare, but I do not want to become unable to do this without you.

delayed_review.review_event: after the user prepares one conversation without the copilot
delayed_review.follow_up_turn: I used the three-question preparation method on my own and asked a colleague to review the opening.
